cases.title: Login page renders email/password fields, Forgot password link, no problems
Empty submit shows "Email and password are required" and sends no request
Wrong password shows "Invalid email or password", stays on /login, no cookie session
Password show/hide toggle switches input type
Forgot password link navigates to /forgot-password
Suspended account: login shows "Account is suspended or inactive"
Locked after 10 failed attempts: UI shows "Too many failed sign-in attempts" (429), correct password also refused
Login API 500 degrades to a readable message (no crash / [object Object])
Successful login lands on Home (/app/dashboard) with session cookies and stored user
Authenticated user opening /login is redirected to the app (PublicRoute)
Logout via profile menu returns to /login, clears stored user + cookies; Back does not reopen the app
ForgotPassword renders; empty email shows Email is required and sends nothing
Known email: generic success message and a reset-token row is stored (hash only)
Unknown email shows the same generic message (no enumeration) and stores nothing
Forgot password 500 -> readable error, no crash
ResetPassword without token: submitting shows "Invalid or missing reset token"
Short password rejected client-side (<8)
Mismatched confirmation rejected
Valid token: success message, redirect to /login, token marked used, new password works / old does not
Reusing the token shows "Invalid or expired reset token"
Expired token shows "Reset token has expired"
AcceptInvite without token: "Invalid or missing invitation token"
Validation: names required, password >= 8, confirmation matches
Invalid token -> server message shown (404 "Invalid or expired invitation")
Expired invitation -> "Invitation has expired" and invitation row EXPIRED
Valid invitation: account created (role/tenant from invite), redirect to /login, can then log in
Re-using the accepted invitation shows an error, no duplicate user
MagicLogin without token: "Missing magic login token"
MagicLogin with unknown token shows error (not blank)
Expired magic token shows "has expired"
Valid magic link on INVITED user: signs in, activates user, goes to /set-password; token single use
SetPassword validation (short, mismatch) and wrong temporary password error
SetPassword success: confirmation then Home; new password works
Used magic token cannot be replayed
MFA user: correct password shows the second step (no session yet)
Short code rejected client-side; wrong code shows server message
Correct TOTP completes sign-in to Home
Recovery code path signs in once; the same recovery code is then refused
Cancel on the second step returns to the email/password form
MFA user via magic link also gets the second step
Deleting only the access cookie: next navigation silently refreshes (stays signed in)
Deleting all session cookies redirects to /login and clears stored user
Unauthenticated deep link /app/campaigns redirects to /login, then back to the target after login
